title: Prove sharp mixed-rank invoice envelopes with touching roots (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a sharp mixed-rank power-invoice envelope, including exact interior touching multiplicity, and supply a portable integer certificate checker. Claim type: scoped algebraic proof with finite corroboration. The examples are synthetic invoices; no physical supplier or new kappa is claimed.

```text
D(t) = epsilon + lambda product_i(a_i^(q*t)-a_i^p), even positive factor count
minimum D = epsilon, uniquely at t=p/q; zero multiplicity = factor count if epsilon=0
6 - 3*4^t - 2*9^t + 36^t = (4^t-2)(9^t-3)
```

The four-rank example has a unique double zero at 1/2. Adding one H1 gives sharp minimum gap one. The checker compares the full new-paid minus new-targets minus old-paid plus old-targets coefficients with the supplied factor expansion, including rank collisions and target debits.

New proof application, integer invoice family and checker produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman #5788 for the explicit touching-root continuation and general-rank comparison context, zxv for signed-invoice accounting, mightyOil for moment-order context, and woklerx for the specialized crossing predecessor. Their results are cited, not audited or replayed. Elementary algebra and calculus are classical methods; no literature priority for them is claimed.

## Evidence

Before: #5788 explicitly leaves touching-root multiplicity outside its simple-interior-witness closure. This PR changes that premise for a declared synchronized-factor family; it does not retest the predecessor.

After: the written proof gives the sharp envelope for every real exponent and arbitrary finite positive even factor count. Local CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass all 696 contexts, 4,176 certificates, 49,944 expanded support entries, 23,472 exact rational-power evaluations and 26 controls. The direct registered commands took 1.095 and 1.086 seconds locally, below their 60-second limits. These are replay timings, not a performance improvement claim.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/mixed-rank-touching-envelope/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/mixed-rank-touching-envelope/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-rank-touching-envelope
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/mixed-rank-touching-envelope --check-source-history --check-modes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B research/mixed-rank-touching-envelope/envelope.py research/mixed-rank-touching-envelope/EXAMPLE.json
```

The verifier prints a generated receipt bound to package/input hashes and `PASS_MIXED_RANK_TOUCHING_ENVELOPE`. Registered replays, committed-byte/mode/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass at `0e80c6baa599d5b110401e1fd041fe45005984b7`. Both normal and optimized replays also pass from a read-only export with Git absent from PATH; every exported byte and mode is unchanged. Standard library only. The checker and verifier write no files.

Canonical main was refreshed before work and submission and remains `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. Live overlap covered 437 open PRs and 5,361 Discussion records with complete pagination; distinctive all-main README and merged-PR searches supplement the sparse local-note search. This coverage is not proof of novelty.

## Limitations

The checker accepts 2,4,6,8 factors, bases 2..64, 2<=q<=16, 1<=p<q, integer positive scale and nonnegative offset through 10^60, expanded ranks through 10^9 and counts through 10^60. The proof has no such finite capacities. Certificate discovery and arbitrary exponential-polynomial classification remain open.

No actual changed supplier's bill is supplied. Source extraction, physical target independence, native implementation, restoration, ownership, compiler/supplier admission and a complete multiplication theorem are unclaimed. The selected cold replay, Lean, independent human review and formal proof-kernel review were not run. Selected-frontier files and frozen evidence are untouched.

## Open next questions

- Find one actual source-bound old/new complete invoice pair whose exact difference has this certificate after a justified common bill cancels. Start with sparse coefficient divisibility; physical bill completeness is the blocker.
- Extend the checker to several supplied rational touching points, grouped by exact rational equality. Root recognition outside that specified rational domain is not settled here.

## Related open work

- #5788 supplies the general-rank all-exponent comparator and this question. This PR adds sharp synchronized touching-point envelopes using factor identity certificates; it does not change or validate that implementation.
- #5768 certifies winner regions for common-base invoices using Sturm methods. This PR handles a restricted mixed-rank family, including ranks 4 and 9, with a different exact certificate. No common numerical fixture was recomputed for comparison.

- #5888 proves hardness for transported coframe rank-power optimization. It uses the same power-tariff quantity on a different finite-word family; it neither computes these synchronized invoice envelopes nor supplies a shared numerical fixture.

## CI notes

At commit `0e80c6baa599d5b110401e1fd041fe45005984b7`, [run 40495697539](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40495697539) failed in `plan` at **Onboarding helper tests**. This was the only failed step. All ten failure/error entries are in unchanged `tests/test_research_current_assignment.py`, with the final summary `FAILED (failures=8, errors=2, skipped=22)`.

The two errors are `KeyError: 'follow_up_steps'` and `KeyError: 'catalog_first_step'`. The eight failure entries concern the frozen-card count (`0 != 16`), missing-helper/reference rejection and sparse-reference receipts. All ten entries match [PR #5886's plan log](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40495644209/job/122160269358) exactly. This confirms the shared onboarding failure on main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`; this PR changes only its new research package. No shared code or tests were changed to address it.

**`replay` was skipped. Hosted replay has not certified this package; only the local package checks reported above have run.** No hosted scientific success is claimed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. The diff adds one opt-in research package and changes no shared implementation or selected result.
